description: Express.js route handlers for authentication endpoints including user registration, login, and profile retrieval, with Swagger API documentation annotations.

methods.name: POST /auth/register
methods.description: Handles user registration, including validation, password hashing, user creation, and JWT token generation.

methods.name: POST /auth/login
methods.description: Handles user login, including credential validation, password comparison, and JWT token issuance.

methods.name: GET /auth/me
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user's profile information.
